title: K-Knuth shape-interval Conjecture 7.6：首个未验证字母规模 \(n=8\)
summary: Complete exact enumeration and an independent no-import verifier certify Conjecture 7.6 for every alphabet of cardinality at most eight. The general unbounded-alphabet conjecture remains open.
